title: Bitumen
summary: Bitumen for roads that are measured and laid for a smoother run.
method: The line is set out before the mix arrives. Tippers bring the bitumen. Vibratory rollers finish the surface. The same people lay bitumen and concrete.
procedure:
Measure the road. The scope comes before a promise.
Shape the run with the grader and the backhoe loaders.
Bring the bitumen with the tippers.
Lay the course on the measured line.
Roll with the vibratory rollers.
Leave a surface the next journey can use.

title: Pavement concrete
summary: Concrete for roads in yards, plants, and public work.
method: Concrete for a road comes from the ready-mix plant and the transit mixers. The line is measured, the slab is placed, and the finish is for a yard, a plant, or a public run.
procedure:
Set out the road.
Batch at the ready-mix plant.
Carry the concrete in the transit mixers.
Place the slab on the measured line.
Finish the surface for the yard or the public run.

title: Foundation concrete
summary: Concrete for machine foundations, special foundations, and mass pours.
method: Foundations for plant and machinery, including the ones the ground or the machine asks for. Mass concrete sits with that work. Excavators and backhoe loaders open the ground. The ready-mix plant and the transit mixers supply the pour.
procedure:
Read the ground and the machine before a price is promised.
Open the excavation with the excavators and the backhoe loaders.
Set the line.
Pour from the ready-mix plant through the transit mixers.
Leave a base the machine can stand on.

title: Epoxy
summary: A finish for factory floors, after the worn surface is repaired.
method: A worn floor is repaired first. Epoxy goes on where the shed needs a surface that can take the work.
procedure:
Look at the floor that is already there.
Repair what will not hold a finish.
Lay the epoxy on the repaired surface.
Hand the shed back as a working floor.

title: Gabion stone
summary: Stone held in mesh, for slopes and channels.
method: The stone stays in the mesh. The wall follows the slope or the channel. The line is set to the ground.
procedure:
Walk the slope or the channel.
Set the mesh to that line.
Fill the mesh with stone.
Keep the stone inside the mesh.
Leave the wall following the ground.

title: Thermoplastic marking
summary: Thermoplastic paint and signs for parking bays.
method: A yard needs bays, lines, and signs before the machines move. Thermoplastic paint marks the bays. Plotting sets out a new site the same way: the line first.
procedure:
Plot the yard or the new site.
Mark the bays.
Lay the thermoplastic lines.
Fix the signs.
Leave a yard the machines can circulate in.

title: Masonry and reinforced concrete
summary: Brick, masonry, and the reinforced concrete inside a building frame.
method: Frames, brick, and masonry for a building. Reinforced concrete sits inside this work. The ready-mix plant supplies that concrete.
procedure:
Set out the building.
Raise the frame.
Lay the brick and the masonry.
Place the reinforced concrete from the plant.
Finish a building that can be used.
